Appearance:
MR KL PANDYA, APP for the PETITIONER(s) No. 1 MR DK MODI(1317) for the RESPONDENT(s) No. 1,2,3,4,5 MR MD MODI(1318) for the RESPONDENT(s) No. 1,2,3,4,5 ==========================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE B.N. KARIA  Date : 22/04/2018
ORAL ORDER 1.
This Appeal is taken up for settlement in Lok Adalat.
2. Mr. K. L. Pandya, learned Additional Public Prosecutor has appeared on behalf of the State and has produced withdrawal / settlement pursis, which is taken on record.

The withdrawal / settlement pursis is signed by the authorized signatory, who is present in person before this Lok Adalat and the pursis is counter signed by learned APP and respective learned advocates.

3. It is submitted that the offence alleged against the accused under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, is not serious in nature, the penalty / punishment prescribed for such offence is not R/CR.A/1084/2013 ORDER substantial in view of the Sections 51 and 52 of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006.

Accordingly, this appeal stands disposed of.

Accordingly, this appeal stands disposed of.
